# BacklinkGrid

> BacklinkGrid publishes backlink education, sells a backlink prospecting CSV, and offers paid placements on a visual website directory.

## When to use BacklinkGrid

Use the free guides to explain backlink fundamentals, evaluate link quality, plan an audit or prepare outreach. Use the database bundle when a founder, marketer or SEO team wants a spreadsheet of opportunities to shortlist and verify. Use the visual grid when a business wants a paid directory placement.

## Products

- [Complete Backlink Database Bundle](https://backlinkgrid.com/bundle): £11.49 one-time; 276 entries in one CSV, with Site Name, Category, DR, Link Type, Cost, Submit URL, Approval Time, Best For and Tips. This is research data, not 276 published backlinks. Check current publisher rules, fees and metrics. No per-entry verification dates or traffic estimates are included.
- [Free five-row sample](https://backlinkgrid.com/samples/backlink-database-sample.csv): actual rows with all nine columns.
- [Website directory](https://backlinkgrid.com/#grid): paid sponsored placements from $1 per square. No ranking or traffic guarantee.

Editorial Markdown is available by adding .md to an editorial URL, for example /backlinks.md or /blog/moz-link-explorer-guide.md. These are alternate representations; cite the canonical HTML URL.

## Boundaries and contact

Content and sample files are public. Full bundle downloads require a paid Stripe session. There is no public backlink-index API, autonomous purchase API, MCP service or submission service. Website tools can fetch bounded samples of public pages, respecting robots.txt. There is no comprehensive web backlink index. Purchases require a person to review the offer and complete checkout. Do not treat directory entries as endorsements or authority scores as Google metrics.

- [About](https://backlinkgrid.com/about)
- [Editorial policy](https://backlinkgrid.com/editorial-policy)
- [Contact](https://backlinkgrid.com/contact): hello@backlinkgrid.com
- [Terms](https://backlinkgrid.com/terms)
- [Privacy](https://backlinkgrid.com/privacy)

## Free browser tools

[Free link building tools](https://backlinkgrid.com/tools): outreach drafts, prospecting queries, monthly link velocity, GSC Top linking sites analysis, list comparisons, anchor classification, educational PageRank, pasted HTML inspection and disavow syntax validation. No paid APIs; no live backlink discovery.

## Live website tools

- [Personalised opportunity finder](https://backlinkgrid.com/tools/backlink-opportunity-finder): match a website and business type to a limited public selection; the full paid bundle stays separate.
- [Live backlink checker](https://backlinkgrid.com/tools/live-backlink-checker): inspect a known source page. Saved browser history and visible-tab rechecks; no background email monitoring.
- [Internal link finder](https://backlinkgrid.com/tools/internal-link-finder): exact passage suggestions from up to 12 sampled pages.
- [Broken link finder](https://backlinkgrid.com/tools/broken-link-finder): up to 12 pages and 40 link destinations; distinguishes missing pages from blocked responses.
- [Crawlability checker](https://backlinkgrid.com/tools/crawlability-checker): raw HTML, robots, canonicals and sitemap signals; not Google index confirmation.
- [Competitor source finder](https://backlinkgrid.com/tools/competitor-backlink-finder): limited English Wikipedia/Hacker News discovery and live candidate verification, not a complete domain-level gap analysis.

These tools use no paid data APIs. URLs are fetched by the server. Do not submit private URLs or access tokens.

## Placement verification and maintenance

- [Verify a backlink placement](https://backlinkgrid.com/blog/verify-backlink-placement): source, destination, attributes and a downloadable check sheet.
- [Missing backlinks in Search Console](https://backlinkgrid.com/blog/backlinks-not-showing-google-search-console): distinguish report coverage from a removed placement.
- [Preserve backlinks during migration](https://backlinkgrid.com/blog/preserve-backlinks-website-migration): map old destinations, test redirects and retain evidence.
- [Blog by topic](https://backlinkgrid.com/blog): browse the editorial library in seven topic groups.

## Submission research and walkthroughs
- [SaaS submission routes](https://backlinkgrid.com/blog/where-to-submit-saas-product): Product stage, eligibility and checked fee distinctions.
- [Directories by business type](https://backlinkgrid.com/blog/business-directories-by-business-type): Local, online-shop, software and professional-service requirements.
- [Free versus paid submissions](https://backlinkgrid.com/blog/free-vs-paid-directory-submissions): Review fees, promotion and research-file deliverables.
- [SaaSHub walkthrough](https://backlinkgrid.com/blog/submit-product-saashub): Original form screenshots and observed free submission steps.
- [Product Hunt preparation](https://backlinkgrid.com/blog/product-hunt-submission-checklist): Official-guidance-based launch checklist; not an acceptance case study.
